title: HTML Living Standard
supports: Document structure; elements and attributes; forms; embedded content; interactive elements; parsing; obsolete features
explanation: The normative standard for HTML. Use it to verify element definitions, parsing behavior, attributes, forms, embedded content, and whether a legacy feature remains conforming. It is detailed and technical, so pair it with a focused lesson before reading the relevant section.
example: When checking whether an attribute is valid on a given element, look up that element and its content/attribute rules in the Living Standard rather than relying on an old snippet.
